result.instructions: Tools for Mindbody, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mindbody data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run mindbody_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mindbody_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mindbody_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. mindbody_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mindbody_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List the Mindbody sites (businesses) your developer account can access, or details for specific site ids. A cheap way to confirm the API key works. Mindbody: GET /site/sites.

site_ids.description: Only these site ids (returns more detail per site).

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the business's locations (studios / branches) with address, phone and amenities. Location ids are needed to book appointments. Mindbody: GET /site/locations.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_session_types
tools.title: List session types
tools.description: List the session types (the bookable kinds of class or appointment, e.g. '60-min massage') used at the site. Session type ids drive appointment availability and booking. Mindbody: GET /site/sessiontypes.

program_ids.description: Only session types in these program ids.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_classes
tools.title: List scheduled classes
tools.description: List scheduled class occurrences in a date range — time, class description, teacher, location, capacity, booked/waitlist counts and cancellation status. Mindbody: GET /class/classes.

start_date_time.description: Start of the range (default today) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

end_date_time.description: End of the range (default today; compares dates, not times) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

class_schedule_ids.description: Only classes from these class schedule ids.

staff_ids.description: Only taught by these staff ids.

client_id.description: View the list as this client (may reveal client-specific pricing).

hide_canceled_classes.description: Drop canceled classes from the response.

last_modified_date.description: Only classes modified on or after this date — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_class_schedules
tools.title: List class schedules
tools.description: List recurring class schedules (the templates that generate class occurrences) — days, times, teacher, location and date span. Mindbody: GET /class/classschedules.

start_date.description: Only schedules active on or after this day (default today) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

end_date.description: Only schedules active on or before this day (default start_date) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

staff_ids.description: Only taught by these staff ids.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_get_class_visits
tools.title: Get a class's visits (roster)
tools.description: Get one class with its visits — the roster of clients booked into it, with sign-in / late-cancel status. Mindbody: GET /class/classvisits.

last_modified_date.description: Only visits modified on or after this date — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

tools.name: mindbody_list_bookable_items
tools.title: Find bookable appointment slots
tools.description: Find appointment availability — which staff can deliver the given session types, where, and in which time windows. Use before mindbody_add_appointment. Mindbody: GET /appointment/bookableitems.

session_type_ids.description: Session type ids to find availability for (see mindbody_list_session_types).

start_date.description: Start of the range (default today) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

end_date.description: End of the range (default start_date) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

staff_ids.description: Only these staff ids (omit for all staff).

appointment_id.description: Exclude this existing appointment (useful when rescheduling).

ignore_default_session_length.description: Also return availabilities that differ from the session type's default length.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_staff_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List booked appointments in a date range, by staff member, client or appointment id — the appointment book. Mindbody: GET /appointment/staffappointments.

start_date.description: Start of the range (default today) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

end_date.description: End of the range (default start_date) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

staff_ids.description: Only these staff ids (omit for all staff).

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_clients
tools.title: Search clients
tools.description: Search or fetch client records by name/email text or by client ids (max 20 ids) — contact details, status, alerts, home location. Requires a staff user token. Mindbody: GET /client/clients.

search_text.description: Match against first name, last name and email.

is_prospect.description: true = only prospects; false = only non-prospects.

last_modified_date.description: Only clients modified on or after this date — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_client_visits
tools.title: List a client's visits
tools.description: List a client's past and scheduled visits (class and appointment attendance) in a date range, optionally only unpaid ones. Mindbody: GET /client/clientvisits.

client_id.description: The client's ID (RSSID — a string, as configured by the business; see mindbody_list_clients).

start_date.description: Only visits on or after this date — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

end_date.description: Only visits on or before this date (default today) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

unpaids_only.description: Only visits not yet paid for.

order.description: Sort by date: desc = newest first.

cross_regional_lookup.description: Include visits at every site in the region.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_client_memberships
tools.title: List a client's active memberships
tools.description: List a client's active memberships (auto-renewing pricing options) with remaining counts and expiry. Mindbody: GET /client/activeclientmemberships.

client_id.description: The client's ID (RSSID — a string, as configured by the business; see mindbody_list_clients).

location_id.description: Only memberships usable at this location (not with cross_regional_lookup).

cross_regional_lookup.description: Search up to ten associated sites in the region.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_get_client_account_balances
tools.title: Get client account balances
tools.description: Get the account balance for one or more clients (what they owe or hold in credit), optionally as of a date. Mindbody: GET /client/clientaccountbalances.

client_ids.description: The client ids to get balances for.

balance_date.description: Balance as of this date (default today) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

class_id.description: Balance relative to this class/event id.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List staff members (instructors, practitioners). Filter by role, or find who is available for a session type at a location and time (session_type_id + location_id + start_date_time together). Without a staff token only public fields return. Mindbody: GET /staff/staff.

session_type_id.description: Only staff available for this session type (needs location_id and start_date_time).

location_id.description: Only staff available at this location (needs session_type_id and start_date_time).

start_date_time.description: Only staff available at this time (needs session_type_id and location_id) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_services
tools.title: List pricing options
tools.description: List the pricing options (services — class packs, drop-ins, intro offers) for sale at the site, with price, online price, count and expiry. Read only. Mindbody: GET /sale/services.

program_ids.description: Only pricing options in these program ids.

session_type_ids.description: Only pricing options for these session type ids.

class_id.description: Only pricing options usable for this class id.

class_schedule_id.description: Only pricing options usable for this class schedule id.

location_id.description: Compute TaxRate/TaxIncluded for this location (does not filter).

staff_id.description: Show this staff member's per-staff pricing, if the site uses it.

hide_related_programs.description: Omit pricing options of related programs.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List completed sales at the site in a date/time range — purchased items, payments and client. Read only. Mindbody: GET /sale/sales.

start_sale_date_time.description: Only sales after this date/time — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

end_sale_date_time.description: Only sales before this date/time — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

payment_method_id.description: Only sales paid with this payment method id.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

tools.name: mindbody_add_client_to_class
tools.title: Book a client into a class
tools.description: Book a client into a class (or onto its waiting list). Does not take payment: by default no pricing option is required; set require_payment to insist the client has a usable one on account. Undo from the Mindbody front desk. Pass test: true to validate only. Mindbody: POST /class/addclienttoclass.

client_id.description: The client's ID (RSSID — a string, as configured by the business; see mindbody_list_clients).

waitlist.description: Add to the class waiting list instead of the class.

require_payment.description: Require an active, usable pricing option on the client's account.

client_service_id.description: The id of the pricing option already on the client's account to use for this booking.

send_email.description: Send the site's booking confirmation email.

test.description: When true, Mindbody validates the request but commits nothing. Use it to dry-run a write.

annotations.title: Book a client into a class

tools.name: mindbody_add_appointment
tools.title: Book an appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment for a client with a staff member at a location. Find a slot first with mindbody_list_bookable_items. No card is charged; apply_payment (Mindbody's default is true) only applies a pricing option already on the client's account. Pass test: true to validate only. Requires a staff user token. Mindbody: POST /appointment/addappointment.

client_id.description: The client's ID (RSSID — a string, as configured by the business; see mindbody_list_clients).

staff_id.description: The staff member delivering the appointment.

end_date_time.description: End, ISO 8601. Default: start + the default duration.

duration.description: Override the default duration, in minutes.

staff_requested.description: The client asked for this staff member specifically.

apply_payment.description: Apply a pricing option already on the client's account (Mindbody default: true).

is_waitlist.description: Add to the appointment waiting list instead.

test.description: When true, Mindbody validates the request but commits nothing. Use it to dry-run a write.

tools.name: mindbody_update_appointment
tools.title: Update an appointment
tools.description: Reschedule or edit an appointment (start/end time, staff, session type, notes — the only fields Mindbody lets you change) and/or move it through its status: confirm, unconfirm, arrive, unarrive, complete. Cancel and late-cancel are deliberately not offered (a late cancel can charge the client). Pass test: true to validate only. Requires a staff user token. Mindbody: POST /appointment/updateappointment.

test.description: When true, Mindbody validates the request but commits nothing. Use it to dry-run a write.

tools.name: mindbody_add_client
tools.title: Add a client
tools.description: Create a new client record (first and last name required; the site may require more — Mindbody reports which). No card or billing data is accepted. Pass test: true to validate only. Mindbody: POST /client/addclient.

gender.description: Gender, as configured at the site (see the site's genders).

referred_by.description: How the client was referred (one of the site's referral types).

is_prospect.description: Mark the client as a prospect (only if the site allows prospects).

send_account_emails.description: Opt in/out of account notification emails.

send_schedule_emails.description: Opt in/out of schedule notification emails.

test.description: When true, Mindbody validates the request but commits nothing. Use it to dry-run a write.

tools.name: mindbody_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Update fields on an existing client record — only the fields you pass change. No card or billing data is accepted. cross_regional_update (Mindbody default: true) also updates the client's profiles at the region's other sites. Pass test: true to validate only. Mindbody: POST /client/updateclient.

client_id.description: The client's ID (RSSID — a string, as configured by the business; see mindbody_list_clients).

gender.description: Gender, as configured at the site (see the site's genders).

referred_by.description: How the client was referred (one of the site's referral types).

is_prospect.description: Mark the client as a prospect (only if the site allows prospects).

send_account_emails.description: Opt in/out of account notification emails.

send_schedule_emails.description: Opt in/out of schedule notification emails.

cross_regional_update.description: Propagate to the client's profiles at the region's other sites (Mindbody default: true).

test.description: When true, Mindbody validates the request but commits nothing. Use it to dry-run a write.
